factories.name: newSearchMessagesStep
factories.description: Search one mailbox with IMAP SEARCH by sender, recipient, subject, date, and unseen state, returning a bounded newest-first list of message summaries with UIDs and Message-IDs.

inputSchema.description: SearchMessagesInput selects messages in one mailbox. Every set filter must match. Text filters use IMAP SEARCH, which matches a case-insensitive substring of the header; servers with full-text indexes, such as Dovecot with FTS, may match whole words instead. Confirm exact values, such as the sender address, in the Flow.

beforeDate.description: BeforeDate keeps messages that arrived before this date, written YYYY-MM-DD.

from.description: From matches the From header, such as jane@example.com or a domain such as @example.com.

isUnseen.description: IsUnseen keeps only messages without the \Seen flag; false matches seen and unseen messages.

limit.description: Limit is the number of summaries to return, from 1 through MaxSearchLimit; zero uses DefaultSearchLimit.

mailbox.description: Mailbox is the mailbox to search; blank uses DefaultMailbox.

olderThanUid.description: OlderThanUID continues a search: only messages with a smaller UID match. Set it from the previous Result's NextOlderThanUID together with UIDValidity.

sinceDate.description: SinceDate keeps messages that arrived on or after this date, written YYYY-MM-DD. IMAP compares the server's internal arrival date in the server's time zone and ignores the time of day.

uidValidity.description: UIDValidity is required with OlderThanUID; a changed UIDVALIDITY selects providerRejected.

factories.name: newGetMessageStep
factories.description: Read one message by mailbox, UIDVALIDITY, and UID without marking it seen, returning its headers, a bounded plain-text body, and attachment names and sizes without their content.

MessageReference.description: MessageReference identifies one message in one IMAP mailbox. A UID names the same message only while the mailbox keeps the same UIDVALIDITY, so every operation that takes a reference checks UIDVALIDITY first and selects notFound when it changed.

mailbox.description: Mailbox is the IMAP mailbox name, such as INBOX or Archive.

uid.description: UID is the message's IMAP unique identifier in Mailbox; it is required.

uidValidity.description: UIDValidity is the mailbox UIDVALIDITY value that UID belongs to; it is required.

inputSchema.description: GetMessageInput identifies the message to read.

message.description: Message is a reference from searchMessages; its UIDValidity must still match the mailbox.

factories.name: newSendMessageStep
factories.description: Send one plain-text message over SMTP with a Message-ID derived from the Step's idempotency key. SMTP has no idempotency, so the Step runs with sync durability and submits at most once per Step execution.

inputSchema.description: SendMessageInput is one new plain-text message.

bcc.description: Bcc lists blind-copy recipients; they receive the message but appear in no header.

cc.description: Cc lists bare ASCII copy recipients.

replyTo.description: ReplyTo is an optional bare address that replies should go to instead of the sender.

subject.description: Subject is one line of at most MaxSubjectBytes; non-ASCII text is encoded for mail headers.

text.description: Text is the UTF-8 plain-text body of at most MaxSendTextBytes. It is sent as quoted-printable.

to.description: To lists bare ASCII recipient addresses; at least one is required.

factories.name: newReplyToMessageStep
factories.description: Reply to one IMAP message over SMTP with In-Reply-To, References, and a Re subject so mail clients thread it, submitting at most once per Step execution like sendMessage.

MessageReference.description: MessageReference identifies one message in one IMAP mailbox. A UID names the same message only while the mailbox keeps the same UIDVALIDITY, so every operation that takes a reference checks UIDVALIDITY first and selects notFound when it changed.

mailbox.description: Mailbox is the IMAP mailbox name, such as INBOX or Archive.

uid.description: UID is the message's IMAP unique identifier in Mailbox; it is required.

uidValidity.description: UIDValidity is the mailbox UIDVALIDITY value that UID belongs to; it is required.

inputSchema.description: ReplyToMessageInput is one plain-text reply to a message in an IMAP mailbox.

cc.description: Cc lists additional bare ASCII copy recipients.

isReplyAll.description: IsReplyAll also addresses the original To and Cc recipients, except the connection's own sender address.

message.description: Message is a reference from searchMessages; its UIDValidity must still match the mailbox.

text.description: Text is the UTF-8 plain-text reply of at most MaxSendTextBytes. The connector does not quote the original message; include any quotation in Text.

factories.name: newMoveMessageStep
factories.description: Move one message to another mailbox with IMAP MOVE; a repeated attempt that finds the message already moved reports it moved instead of failing.

MessageReference.description: MessageReference identifies one message in one IMAP mailbox. A UID names the same message only while the mailbox keeps the same UIDVALIDITY, so every operation that takes a reference checks UIDVALIDITY first and selects notFound when it changed.

mailbox.description: Mailbox is the IMAP mailbox name, such as INBOX or Archive.

uid.description: UID is the message's IMAP unique identifier in Mailbox; it is required.

uidValidity.description: UIDValidity is the mailbox UIDVALIDITY value that UID belongs to; it is required.

inputSchema.description: MoveMessageInput moves one message to another mailbox.

destinationMailbox.description: DestinationMailbox is an existing mailbox, such as Archive; the connector never creates one.

message.description: Message is a reference from searchMessages; its UIDValidity must still match the source mailbox.

messageId.description: MessageID is the message's Message-ID without angle brackets, from searchMessages. When set, it must match the message at the UID, and an attempt that finds the UID gone looks for this Message-ID in the destination and selects moved instead of notFound. Blank skips both checks.

factories.name: newSetFlagsStep
factories.description: Set or clear the seen, flagged, and answered flags of one message to absolute values, so a repeated attempt changes nothing twice.

MessageReference.description: MessageReference identifies one message in one IMAP mailbox. A UID names the same message only while the mailbox keeps the same UIDVALIDITY, so every operation that takes a reference checks UIDVALIDITY first and selects notFound when it changed.

mailbox.description: Mailbox is the IMAP mailbox name, such as INBOX or Archive.

uid.description: UID is the message's IMAP unique identifier in Mailbox; it is required.

uidValidity.description: UIDValidity is the mailbox UIDVALIDITY value that UID belongs to; it is required.

inputSchema.description: SetFlagsInput sets message flags to absolute values. A nil field leaves that flag unchanged; at least one field is required.

isAnswered.description: IsAnswered sets or clears \Answered, which mail clients show as replied.

isFlagged.description: IsFlagged sets or clears \Flagged, which mail clients show as starred or flagged.

isSeen.description: IsSeen sets (true) or clears (false) \Seen, which mail clients show as read.

message.description: Message is a reference from searchMessages; its UIDValidity must still match the mailbox.
